[{"node":"menu_content107","element":"menu_content","data":{"label":"Docs Menus And Items","key":"docs_menus_and_items_menu_content","id":"docs_menus_and_items_menu_content","name":"docs_menus_and_items_menu_content"},"elements":[{"node":"markdown101","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Menus and items","key":"md_menus_and_items","id":"menus-and-items","name":"md_menus_and_items","value":"# Menus and items

What Ren POS sells are normal **ERPNext Items**. A **menu** (Ren Menu) picks which items are offered and can give them their own price. Nothing is kept twice: editing an item from the POS edits the same Item you see in the Desk.

| On the Item (ERPNext) | On the menu |
|---|---|
| name, item group, photo, taxes | whether it is offered |
| sizes (variants) | its price on this menu (optional) |
| options and combos (Restaurant tab) | when the menu is in force |
| recipe (BOM), base price (price list) | sold out (86) |"}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"The Menu Manager","key":"md_the_menu_manager","id":"the-menu-manager","name":"md_the_menu_manager","value":"# The Menu Manager

Open the POS, tap the **pencil**, then **Menu**. People whose role has **Edit menus** can use it.

- **Menus** on the left: create, enable or disable, delete, and **Use as the restaurant's menu**. Tags show which menu is the restaurant's, which ones a room uses, and which one is in force by its schedule.
- **Items** of the selected menu: search, add, remove, set a **price on this menu** (empty: the price list's price). Categories on the POS come from each item's **Item Group**.
- **New item** or **Edit item** opens the item editor:
  - **Basics**: name, group, photo, description, price, **Dietary & allergens** tags.
  - **Sizes**: each size is an ERPNext variant with its own price, stock and recipe (Small, Large…).
  - **Options & combo**: see [Options, combos and sizes](/Docs/Options%20and%20Combos). **Preview** shows how the order line would look.
  - **Recipe**: the ingredients of one portion and their cost. See [Recipes and stock](/Docs/Recipes).
  - **Keep stock of this item**: for bottled drinks or desserts bought ready. Dishes made in the kitchen use a recipe instead.
  - **Menu**: whether it is on the current menu and its price there.

Everything can also be done in the Desk (**Restaurant Menu**, **Items**)."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Which menu is in force","key":"md_which_menu_is_in_force","id":"which-menu-is-in-force","name":"md_which_menu_is_in_force","value":"# Which menu is in force

For each room, the first that applies:

1. the room's own menu (set in the room's settings),
2. a menu whose **In Force** schedule covers the current time (Breakfast 7:00–11:00, Happy Hour 16:00–18:00),
3. the restaurant's **Active Menu**,
4. the company's menu marked **Is Default**.

The POS switches menus by itself when a schedule starts or ends."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Menu tags and filters","key":"md_menu_tags_and_filters","id":"menu-tags-and-filters","name":"md_menu_tags_and_filters","value":"# Menu tags and filters

**Menu Tags** (Vegan, Gluten-free, Contains nuts…) go on items under *Dietary & allergens*. Each tag has a short label for the item cards, and with **Filter in the POS** it becomes a quick filter button on the order screen."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Sold out (86)","key":"md_sold_out_86","id":"sold-out-86","name":"md_sold_out_86","value":"# Sold out (86)

On the order screen, the **86** button lists the menu's items: mark one **Sold out now** and it can't be ordered on any screen until you mark it **Available again**. Sold-out items also disappear from online ordering. The role needs **Mark items sold out (86)**."}},{"node":"markdown106","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Only what is on the menu","key":"md_only_what_is_on_the_menu","id":"only-what-is-on-the-menu","name":"md_only_what_is_on_the_menu","value":"# Only what is on the menu

**Ren Settings → Sell only items on the menu** refuses items that aren't on the table's menu, even if someone tries to add them another way."}}]}]
